stimuli.audioTranscript: Hello! My name is Yakup. This is my daily routine. I wake up at seven o'clock. I have breakfast at seven twenty. Then, I leave home at seven forty. I go to school by tram. I attend my classes at eight thirty. My favorite subject is PE because I love sports. I arrive home at three o'clock in the afternoon.
